Compliance Intake Concierge: automated evidence bundles & residency flagging

Build an intake + automation flow for customer compliance requests that reduces manual evidence gathering and shortens audit response time. The feature will create a guided questionnaire, auto-collect residency and retention configuration snapshots, and generate a time-stamped evidence bundle (PDF + structured index) suitable for DPA / SOC / customer audits.
In-scope: (1) Questionnaire builder templates for common audit asks (DPA, SOC, Data Residency, Retention); (2) Automated collection of system snapshots: region settings, retention policies, exportable CSV of audit-relevant logs; (3) One-click evidence bundle generation with manifest and MD5 checksums; (4) Admin-facing request tracker with status updates and role-based visibility; (5) Minimal legal templates for DPA acknowledgement to attach to bundles.
Out-of-scope for this ticket: full legal review of DPA clauses, long-term archival storage beyond 90 days for exported bundles, end-to-end encrypted on-prem bundle transfer tooling, and automated remediation of misconfigured customer residency settings (these will be separate engineering/ops initiatives).
PM can create a questionnaire from a template and add custom fields
When a request is submitted, the system generates a bundle that includes: questionnaire responses, region/residency snapshot, retention policy snapshot, and a checksumed manifest
Bundle generation completes within SLA: 2 minutes for standard customers, 10 minutes for large accounts
Admin UI shows request lifecycle (Submitted → In Progress → Evidence Ready → Delivered) and allows attaching a GitHub PR or internal incident when applicable
Evidence bundles are downloadable as a ZIP with PDF summary and a machine-readable index (CSV)
Audit logs record who generated/downloaded bundles and include timestamps and request IDs
Reduce mean time to first evidence delivery from 5 business days to <6 hours for standard requests
>70% of incoming questionnaire-based requests resolved without engineering manual work within 30 days of release
Customer satisfaction (CSAT) for compliance requests increases from baseline by 15%
Number of legal/SE hours spent per audit request reduced by 60%
Sensitive data included in exported bundles could be mishandled if access controls are not strict
Automated snapshots may not capture bespoke customer configurations for private/on-prem deployments
Legal may require additional attestations delaying rollout
Large accounts with long log retention may cause bundle generation timeouts
Leverage export-service (ENG-2319) to snapshot residency/retention configs
Create template set for DPA/SOC with conditional fields for region-specific residency laws
Design: make evidence bundle verifiable via manifest and checksums; avoid embedding raw PII where possible
Ops: rotate temp presigned URLs for large bundles and record access in audit logs
Alpha (internal): 2026-03-25 - questionnaire + manual bundle generation feature for ops
Beta (selected customers): 2026-04-20 - automated bundle generator + admin tracker
GA: 2026-05-15 - public docs, self-serve, and SLA targets
